about: Super Cool Ski Instructor is South Park's Thumper, a deadpan ski instructor with his face shielded by a ski mask and goggles, giving the boys extremely blunt advice on the slopes. His signature warning is that if you do something stupid, "you're gonna have a bad time." The meme uses him to give earnest advice about obviously bad decisions, delivered in the same flat, slightly patronizing tone.
origin: The character comes from the South Park episode "Asspen" (2002), set at an Aspen, Colorado ski resort, where Thumper tries to teach Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny to ski.
usage:
The top box sets up the bad decision as an "if you..." clause, and the bottom box is Thumper's "you're gonna have a bad time". The default leaves the top empty, which also works when you'd rather put the context in a post title.

Think of it as a public safety notice: microwaving fish at the office, skipping leg day, pulling an all-nighter before a final, going to IKEA on a Saturday, or playing ranked tired. The warning is funnier when the bad time is obvious and the advice is delivered completely straight.
